topic.readerProblem: A founder, marketer or agency person weighing AEOeye against Trakkr wants to know which fits their job, what each costs, which engines each covers and where Trakkr is the better pick.
topic.connection: AEOeye runs one-time AI visibility audits (free ChatGPT check, $29 five-engine report) on the same buyer questions Trakkr tracks daily on a subscription; the page explains the difference and recommends Trakkr where continuous monitoring is the real need.

assessment: A documentation-based head-to-head built only from Trakkr's own pricing page, billing guide, FAQ and terms read on 2026-10-03; it discloses near the top that we have not used Trakkr hands-on and that AEOeye is our product. It gives a verdict first, a ten-row table, plain admissions of where Trakkr is stronger (repeated sampling, volume, eight models, API and agency features), a labelled cost-per-answer calculation, and the limits of a one-snapshot AEOeye audit using SparkToro's run-to-run variance study. It replaces the earlier version's wrong claims (free multi-engine audit, $79 and $399 prices, no-card trial) and deliberately makes no claim about Trakkr's data accuracy, hands-on experience or outcomes.

sources.supports: Growth $100/month or $1,000/year (1 brand, 50 prompts, 8 models, 3 seats, MCP), Scale $500/month or $5,000/year (10 brands, unlimited seats, REST API, white-label), Enterprise from $1,000/month; 12,000 data points a month on Growth; data point defined as a single query to an AI model; 14-day trial with card required.

Eight tracked models on every plan; prompts sent to providers' own APIs and recorded daily; no free version, 14-day card-required Growth trial; 50 active prompts per brand; advice to start with 5 to 20 questions; citations, perception, competitors, page actions and Agent descriptions; CSV, Sheets and Looker Studio export.

Plan feature matrix (MCP on both plans; REST API and Looker Studio on Scale only; unlimited seats and white-label portal on Scale), add-on prices (extra brand $50, extra prompts $39/$59/$99 per brand), trial terms.
14-day money-back guarantee for new subscribers; annual plans charged upfront and renewing automatically; prices exclude tax.
600 volunteers, 12 prompts, 2,961 runs on ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI; under 1 in 100 chance of the same brand list twice; author's takeaway to ask 60-100 times and average.
GEO, also known as answer engine optimization (AEO), is the practice of improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems.
